title: Provider file
description: A provider file of authz-agent, version 1 (authz-agent-ADR-0104). The agent reads every provider file in /etc/authz/providers at start.

providers.description: The trusted providers, keyed by name. The name decides which checks a token of the provider gets (ADR-0104 R22).

identityProvider.description: The Keycloak of the platform. Its tokens are identity-provider tokens and get the M2M test of ADR-0092 R6 and R21, so no other identity provider may stand under this name. A token of it is an identity-provider token also when it holds the claim kubernetes.io, and the checks of a Kubernetes token do not apply to it (ADR-0104 R22).

type.description: realms: one issuer per realm, given by issuerTemplate. single: one issuer, given by issuer.

issuerTemplate.description: The iss of the tokens, with {realm} in place of the realm: the path segment of iss that differs between the issuers of this provider, which Keycloak calls a realm (ADR-0104 R19).

readinessRealms.description: Realms whose keys must load before the agent reports ready, each named as it stands in place of {realm} in iss after percent-decoding (ADR-0104 R12, R13, R25).

kubernetes.description: The API server of the cluster. Its tokens are Kubernetes tokens and M2M tokens (ADR-0092 R7), and get the checks of ADR-0094 R16 to R18 and R25 and ADR-0091 R48 (ADR-0104 R22).

jwksUri.description: The address of the keys, over https only (ADR-0094 R32). With jwksBearerTokenFile it is an in-cluster address (ADR-0104 R28).

jwksBearerTokenFile.description: The absolute path of the file whose token goes with the requests for the keys (ADR-0104 R14, R24). At start the agent compares the iss of that token with issuer and warns when they differ or the token holds no iss it can read (ADR-0104 R29).

issuer.description: The iss of the tokens, compared byte for byte (ADR-0104 R19).

mode.description: matchAny: aud must hold one of values. ignore: the agent does not check aud, whether the token has one or not.

jwksUri.description: The address of the keys (ADR-0104 R23).

url.description: An absolute URL of printable ASCII characters, without a space, a fragment, {, or }.

realmTemplateUrl.description: Like url, except that it holds {realm} once, as one whole path segment.
